outgoing.name: Africa
outgoing.excerpt: Cyclamen are native to the Mediterranean region from Spain east to Iran, and also in northeast Africa south to Somalia.

outgoing.name: Cultivar
outgoing.excerpt: Selected cyclamen cultivars can have white, bright pink, red or purple flowers.

outgoing.name: Europe
outgoing.excerpt: Several species are hardy and can be grown outdoors in mild climates such as northwest Europe and the Pacific Northwest.

outgoing.name: Forest
outgoing.excerpt: Cyclamen typically grow in dry forest or scrub, where they are at least partly shaded from intense sunlight.

outgoing.name: Fruit
outgoing.excerpt: The fruit is a five-chambered capsule 1-2 cm diameter, containing numerous sticky seeds about 2 mm diameter.
